judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Key Unit Competence statements (same statement-type grain) at the same P2 coordinate under Topic Area 'Numbers and Operations' / Sub-Topic Area 'Whole Numbers'. They state the same operation set (count, read, write, compare, arrange, add and subtract, multiply and divide whole numbers) but over different number ranges: the first is scoped to Unit 1 'Numbers from 0 to 200' and the second to Unit 3 'Numbers from 0 to 1000'. This is a pair-specific substantive extension of range (to three-digit numbers, requiring place value to hundreds/thousands and larger-number computation), so competence with the operations to 200 supports success with the same operations to 1000. Same-rank direction is justified by this explicit range broadening rather than by shared ancestry or the high lexical overlap alone; the within-grade Unit 1 to Unit 3 placement is consistent. Evidence limitation: both endpoints' source evidence is truncated (24 omitted source-evidence items each) and ancestors carry merge context, but the visible competence texts and unit scopes are unambiguous.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are P2 (rank 1, same Grade coordinate) Attitudes and Values Objectives under the shared Topic Area 'Measurement': one asks pupils to appreciate the use of kg and develop the spirit of honesty when weighing (Unit 7, Mass measurements), the other to develop the culture of honesty and accuracy when measuring length (Unit 5, m/dm/cm). Their LCs ('develop the spirit of honesty when weighing' vs 'develop a culture of honesty/accuracy in measuring length') show the same disposition of honest, accurate measurement applied to two complementary measurable attributes, which is substantive dispositional coherence rather than mere shared parent or word overlap. Neither statement deepens, extends, or is a condition for the other, and both sit at the same P2 rank with no evidence of instructional ordering, so a symmetric relatesTo is supported rather than buildsTowards in either direction. Endpoint source evidence is truncated and both endpoints carry upstream merge/audit context, but the visible statement texts are complete and unambiguous for this judgment.
